subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In 2019, marine biologists studied coral samples they had collected from the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.
• The samples were taken from reefs that had experienced bleaching events in recent decades.
• DNA analysis of the samples revealed genetic markers associated with heat tolerance.
• The presence of these markers suggests that some coral populations may be adapting to rising ocean temperatures.
prompt: The student wants to present the Great Barrier Reef study and its conclusions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: As part of a 2019 study of coral adaptation, DNA analysis was conducted on coral samples from the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.
choices.B: A 2019 DNA analysis of coral samples from the Great Barrier Reef suggests that some coral populations may be adapting to rising ocean temperatures.
choices.C: In 2019, marine biologists studied how corals in the Great Barrier Reef had responded to bleaching events in recent decades.
choices.D: Coral samples showing genetic markers for heat tolerance were collected from the Great Barrier Reef in 2019.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence presents the study, describing it as a 2019 DNA analysis of Great Barrier Reef coral samples, and its conclusions, indicating what the analysis suggests about coral adaptation to rising temperatures.
